properties.action_description: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.
The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod.
The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.
The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.
The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.
The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves.
The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper.
The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves, while avoiding the copper sleeves.
